versions.changelog:
Initial release — translates raw VIX value into actionable options-selling guidance with 5-tier classification.

- Maps current VIX reading to one of five strategy zones (calm, normal, seller sweet spot, caution, extreme fear).
- Provides contextual data: 1-year mean, current percentile, and recent tier distributions.
- Gives concise, actionable trading hints for each zone.
- Offers an API endpoint with structured VIX status and mock data for all tiers.
- Triggered by queries like “what's VIX”, “market fear gauge”, and “should I sell premium now”.
